requirements.W01: PASS — observed wreck remains permanently visible beyond ordinary contact memory and is not designatable
requirements.W02: PASS — unobserved destruction publishes no new wreck or combat result
requirements.W03: PASS — a destroyed object can be detected and identified after prior memory has expired
requirements.W04: PASS — confirmed team wreck snapshot stays frozen and unique across observers and reads
requirements.W05: PASS — identical alive/hidden-destroyed public memory accepts designation identically
requirements.W06: PASS — friendly/enemy wreck actions and selection are rejected while dynamic occupancy remains
requirements.W07: PASS — selected destruction falls back to a living friendly; final loss supports safe no-selection UI and shortcuts
requirements.W08: PASS — a replacement scenario inherits no wreck, mode, request, HP, flight or public state
requirements.E01: PASS — normal creation and scenarios default auto, modes are per-unit and profile data stays immutable
requirements.E02: PASS — both teams automatically sense, identify, acquire, aim, fire, impact and damage without input
requirements.E03: PASS — team-only, unidentified, unacquired, lost, blocked, empty-ammo and destroyed states do not authorize auto fire
requirements.E04: PASS — auto uses the same final own-sight and weapon-line recheck as manual fire
requirements.E05: PASS — hold blocks auto shots while retaining observation, handoff, aim and gated manual one-shot
requirements.E06: PASS — hold clears only an unexecuted auto request and preserves launched flights
requirements.E07: PASS — manual/auto overlap fires and consumes ammo once; each impact damages once
requirements.E08: PASS — a confirmed destroyed target is cleared and the existing path acquires and auto-engages another target
requirements.E09: PASS — hidden destruction, HP, target ID and live coordinates do not leak through public status, logs or snapshot
requirements.E10: PASS — enemy auto fire requires its own actual observation and uses separate team-public events
requirements.E11: PASS — equal seed, commands and fixed steps reproduce across batching and repeated UI reads
requirements.E12: PASS — equal-time flights resolve deterministically and launched rounds survive cancellation/destruction
requirements.E13: PASS — gunner loss beyond existing grace hands A to commander-observed B, then reacquires and fires
requirements.E14: PASS — real low weapon-line obstruction switches optically visible A to valid commander B in auto and hold
requirements.E15: PASS — absent, shared-only, unidentified, stale or confirmed-wreck candidates cannot bypass handoff gates
requirements.E16: PASS — interval/aim/slew are not false switch reasons and A reappearance does not oscillate from valid B
requirements.E17: PASS — A-to-B clears unexecuted A preparation, preserves launched flights and advances B through one aim path
requirements.E18: PASS — normal makeTank/fire initialization/replacement scenarios default auto while manual fixtures explicitly request hold
requirements.E19: PASS — player designation replaces A with D, preserves auto and fires D after its normal acquisition/aim gates without G
requirements.E20: PASS — commander candidates hand off by first discovery time despite reversed unit arrays and public keys
requirements.E21: PASS — discovery and identification times stay separate; unidentified contacts do not block and later identification preserves discovery order
requirements.E22: PASS — reobservation preserves first discovery without duplicates; stale/wreck candidates advance to the next valid contact
requirements.E23: PASS — a candidate arriving after cached A obstruction retargets in auto and hold without another weapon-line LOS; hold does not fire
requirements.I01: PASS — frozen WIP09/WIP10 Python and manual-fire fixtures plus the full prior regression remain unchanged
requirements.I02: PASS — actual embedded Worker, stale-response protection, failure fallback and page script order pass
requirements.I03: PASS — source exports, active profile/ammunition, dist, standalone HTML and one-entry ZIP agree on WIP11B

benchmarks.observationFixture: 100 timed fixed 0.05s steps after 20 warmup, both teams sense
benchmarks.autoFixture: 50/100 stationary units, all explicitly auto, 600 timed fixed 0.05s steps after 20 warmup

notRun: Android or iOS physical-device multitouch, thermal and sustained frame-rate testing
limits: Browser mobile checks are Chromium viewports, not physical devices
CPU timings are fixed-step synthetic measurements and are not whole-game FPS
file:// was blocked by environment policy; the exact standalone HTML was tested through local HTTP
WIP10 unobserved-miss dust disclosure remains a separate undecided policy
